cannot_assess: MBTA has not published a station layout for this station, so LastLift cannot check alternatives. See MBTA's alert.
data_report: Sent as a courtesy by an independent developer. We may be misreading the data.
equity: Residents near a station, not riders. ACS 5-year estimates with margins of error. A planning context only.
footer: Unofficial decision-support prototype. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the MBTA or MassDOT. Uses MBTA GTFS and V3 API data under the MassDOT Developers License Agreement. Data may be incomplete or out of date. Always check mbta.com/alerts/access before travelling. Elevator status line 617-222-2828; customer support 617-222-3200 (TTY 711).
history: Based on closures MBTA reported in public alerts, replayed through today's station layout data. Reported closures may differ from actual elevator status, and station layouts changed during this period.
partial: A step-free route exists in the station layout data, but MBTA's alert advises a different route. Follow MBTA's advice on site.
policy_brief: Independent analysis of public data, offered for discussion. Not legal advice, and not a compliance assessment.
risk: A historical frequency estimate. It is not a prediction that any elevator will fail, and not an MBTA figure.
validation: Agreement with MBTA's published alternative-route text, labelled by one person. Small samples, with 95% intervals shown. Disagreements are listed in full.
video_end_card: Unofficial. Not affiliated with the MBTA. Public data. AI-assisted build, disclosed in the README.
